summary: A member answers a question about a vote by recalling the commitment it fulfills.
realLife: Louisiana Senator John Kennedy explained his July 2017 procedural vote on health care by recalling his promise to seek repeal of the Affordable Care Act. He described the vote as one step toward that promise.
inGame: needs: their connection exposed to the press reply. The promise records and the member vote are the two reads.
gates: The vote concerns an outstanding promise.

turns.what: The member explains why the final text led them to depart from their pledge.
turns.pulledBy: The pledge concerned a provision removed before passage.
turns.writesBack: The public explanation links the pledge to the change in text.

turns.what: A supporter who remembers the pledge asks whether their coverage changes with this vote.
turns.pulledBy: The roll call opened debate and the underlying law is still in force.
turns.writesBack: The member’s reply gives the purpose of the vote and leaves the promised change open in the district record.
